notes: Mt Auburn hillside west of Main, south of Taft Park (sheet 189). No street on this sheet carries a suffix; Street added per convention. Thill is not labelled on this sheet (named from sheet 189 and the key map); Loth is printed 'LOTH' along its pipe. Thill (6 in. pipe, ~40 ft between lines at y 637/779 west of Loth) ends at Rice, where its pipe turns south down Rice; east of Loth only Thill's south line is drawn, and that line (y ~774) runs on unbroken across the mouth of Rice ('RICE (NOT IMPROVED)', 40') to Main's east line as the Taft Park boundary, so the Rice/Thill T is placed on the pipe line. Loth T-ends at Thill (its east line closes Thill's north line); Loth and the unnamed ~20 ft alley west of it run SSW off the drawn area at y ~1100 onto sheet 169. Rice runs off the drawn area at about (1306,3830) toward sheet 170 (not a real end). Valencia is printed 'VALENCIA' (40'). Justis is printed 'JUSTIS (TACOMA)' (40'); 'TACOMA' also appears on the house numbers. Main is printed 'MAIN (NOT OPENED)' with 25' north of y 2805 and 'MAIN' 50' south of it; width given as 50. 'ERIE' (no suffix; sheet 182 prints 'ERIE (FEDERAL) (NOT OPENED)', 40'; named Erie Street) leaves Main's east side between lines at y 3533/3677; Main's east line is dashed across its mouth. Mason is printed 'MASON (NOT OPENED)', running NW-SE diagonally from its dead end to Main; east of Main it continues due east as 'MASON' (6 in. pipe at y ~4480; north line y 4400, south line off the sheet), so Mason changes direction at the Main crossing. Calumet (printed 'CALUMET', ~43 ft, only a short stub before the bottom edge) comes in from the SSW and meets the Mason diagonal just west of Main; T placed where its centreline meets Mason's. No alleys cross the Valencia-Justis block.
